rules.text: "size" is a component prop: the caller selects one, accepting xs | sm | md | lg. Realise it as your target's own input — a component API where the target has one, and a modifier class per value, which the consuming page selects, where the target carries only markup and a stylesheet.

"variant" is a component prop: the caller selects one, accepting standard | inverted. Realise it as your target's own input — a component API where the target has one, and a modifier class per value, which the consuming page selects, where the target carries only markup and a stylesheet.
